## [1.5.0](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0) (2026-11-27)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Instagram:** Feed header stays readable over posts and the stories tray ([f652668](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/f652668488b68e55c736559c3a4e3ec142eff7b8))
* **Instagram:** Glass no longer glows brighter than the app in HDR mode ([b3ca394](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/b3ca3946985d47034f050126bbc4c096c37f41a3))
* **Instagram:** Reels caption and buttons no longer vanish after switching tabs ([548361f](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/548361f57ecc05c8964f6853aeefe49118aba54a))
* **Instagram:** Reels shrink into a card above the comments and share sheets ([ad756f5](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/ad756f59181ecf7a268d498d978922e83e3c97f1))
* **Instagram:** Reels strip no longer hides the caption and seek bar ([679300b](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/679300b21d61d524fcf6d1826d911b2f313b9bfb))
* **Instagram:** Share and comments glass no longer breaks over SurfaceView videos ([8e28082](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/8e28082754957aed638327d943c15ffa08c4f427)), closes [#23](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/issues/23)
* **Instagram:** Sheets cover the gesture bar strip over pages behind the bar ([4182b63](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/4182b63051d4d8e625507a811478a441cddfd3a0))
* **Spotify:** Patch description no longer mentions the green selected tab ([d12689b](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/d12689bf4486d368fa8df1675d421639325fc9c7))

### ✨ New Features

* **Instagram:** Full screen Reels, with switches for it and the white title ([ac9a5be](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/ac9a5be1934ffe0e00d3b97c899e06a22c1c6f94))
* **Instagram:** Glass comments setting ([668c653](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/668c653caf149404ce8e620a84ce7de5f8352b8b))

patches.name: Disable dynamic player color
patches.description: Keeps the full player's background one neutral color instead of changing with each song's album art. Switch it on and pick the color (YouTube Music's default, black or dark grey) in the southstar21 Patches menu in the top bar. Requires Morphe Patches with GmsCore support, applied together in Expert mode.

patches.name: Hide Ask Music button
patches.description: Removes the Ask Music AI assistant button (the sparkle) from the top bar, the full player, the mini player, the video's fullscreen controls and the search bar, with its banner. It can be switched off again in the southstar21 Patches menu in the top bar. Requires Morphe Patches with GmsCore support, applied together in Expert mode.

patches.name: Liquid Glass navigation bar
patches.description: Turns the bottom tab bar into floating iOS 26 style Liquid Glass with live background blur and edge refraction, with the mini player docked beside it as round album art with a progress ring, a glass playback bar above, and the content scrolling on behind them. Lightweight glass (the default, switchable to the full effect in the southstar21 Patches menu in the top bar) blurs on Android 14+ and gets a solid pill before that; the full effect adds refraction on Android 13+ and blur on Android 12+. Requires Morphe Patches with GmsCore support, applied together in Expert mode.

options.description: Blur applied to content behind the bar, in dp.
How strongly the glass edge bends the content behind it, from 0 to 100.
Thicker glass, and a press swells the selection into a magnifying drop of glass that wobbles and stretches as you drag it.

patches.name: Bypass signature check
patches.description: Stops Instagram rejecting apps by their signature, which a patched app no longer matches.

patches.name: Conscious gate
patches.description: Gives the home feed, Reels, Explore and stories a daily time budget. In the last 15 seconds they frost over and can only be scrolled, then a gate closes them until the next day. Searching for people, messages and profiles keep working. Off until you switch it on in the settings.

patches.name: Disable Reels
patches.description: Removes reels from the home feed and Explore, and stops scrolling from one reel to the next. Each part is off until you switch it on in the settings.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored posts, stories and reels, and ad units in the home feed. Each part can be switched off in the settings.

patches.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches.description: Adds settings to hide Search, Reels, Create, Messages and other tabs from the bottom bar. Every tab stays until you hide it in the settings.

patches.name: Liquid Glass navigation bar
patches.description: Turns the bottom tab bar into a floating iOS 26 style Liquid Glass pill with live background blur and edge refraction. Refraction needs Android 13+, blur needs Android 12+, older versions get a tinted pill.

options.description: Blur applied to content behind the bar, in dp.
How strongly the glass edge bends the content behind it, from 0 to 100.
Lets feeds scroll underneath the bar so there is something to see through the glass. Turn off if the last item of a list ends up hidden.

patches.name: Remove build expired popup
patches.description: Removes the popup that appears after a while, when the app version ages.

patches.name: View profile picture
patches.description: Adds a button on the profile picture of profile pages that shows the profile picture in full resolution and saves it to the gallery.

patches.name: Liquid Glass navigation bar
patches.description: Turns the bottom tab bar and the mini player above it into floating iOS 26 style Liquid Glass with live background blur and edge refraction. Refraction needs Android 13+, blur needs Android 12+, older versions get a tinted pill.

options.description: Blur applied to content behind the bar, in dp.
How strongly the glass edge bends the content behind it, from 0 to 100.
Thicker glass, and a press swells the selection into a magnifying drop of glass that wobbles and stretches as you drag it.
